title: National Dialogue and Review of Policy Regarding National Athletes Serving National Service
what_it_is: National Dialogue and Review of Policy Regarding National Athletes Serving National Service

sections.label: NS deferment for athletes question
sections.summary: A question asks the Minister for Defence about a national dialogue on athletes' NS expectations and a review of their NS obligations, and about relaxing NS deferment criteria for sports, arts and other fields.

sentences.text: The following question stood in the name of Mr Seah Kian Peng – 4 To ask the Minister for Defence (a) whether the Ministry intends to hold a national dialogue on expectations of national athletes serving their National Service (NS); and (b) whether there will be a review of the policy regarding such athletes and their NS obligations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Defence (a) whether the Government will relax the eligibility criteria for National Service (NS) deferment for young male Singaporeans who have the potential to accomplish significant successes in the sports and arts fields; and (b) whether the Government will consider deferring NS for young male Singaporeans who have the potential to accomplish significant successes in fields other than sports and arts.

sections.label: Poll on NS support
sections.summary: In 2021, 96% of Singaporeans polled affirmed that NS is critical for the defence and security of the country.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: In 2021, 96% of Singaporeans polled affirmed that NS is critical for the defence and security of our country.

sections.label: Universality and equity principles
sections.summary: High national support for NS is attributed to holding unequivocally the fundamental principles of universality and equity for NS.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: On the contrary, this strong support, why it is that we have been able to keep such high levels of national support, there is one key reason.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: We have held, unequivocally, the fundamental principles of universality and equity for NS.

sections.label: NS defaulters jailed
sections.summary: NS is a national commitment of the highest order, and Courts have sentenced defaulters who reneged on their liability to jail.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: It is a national commitment of the highest order and one that we all take very seriously.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: So much so, that for defaulters who reneged on their liability, our Courts have sentenced them to jail.

sections.label: Long-term NS deferment for Olympians
sections.summary: Long-term deferments from full-time NS are exceptional, only for those with potential to win medals at top-tier international competitions like the Olympic Games, and on this basis Joseph Schooling and Quah Zheng Wen were granted eight and five years' deferment for the 2016 and 2020 Olympics.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: Long-term deferments from full-time NS, such as those mentioned by Members, are exceptional, only for those who have potential to win medals at top-tier international competitions like the Olympic Games.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: And on this basis, swimmers Joseph Schooling and Quah Zheng Wen were granted eight years' and five years' deferment respectively for the 2016 and 2020 Olympics.

sections.label: Next NS policy review
sections.summary: When the next review of NS policies is convened, MINDEF will incorporate views across the spectrum of supporters and detractors of deferments and disruptions for sports and arts talent.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: When the next review of NS policies is convened, MINDEF will incorporate views across the spectrum of supporters and detractors of deferments and disruptions for sports and arts talent.

sections.label: MINDEF disruption for NS athletes
sections.summary: MINDEF is prepared to allow more full-time NSmen to disrupt to train and compete in international competitions.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: Some have achieved it, but it is not easy to attain and we must not set unrealistic expectations on all of them.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: However, for those who want to pursue both goals, MINDEF is prepared to allow more to disrupt to train and compete in international competitions during their full-time NS.

sections.label: Deferment for sports and arts talents
sections.summary: Policies exist for deferment for sportsmen and performing arts Singaporeans who perform at competitive and world level.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: One, from what the Minister has said, we have policies in place for deferment for sportsmen and performing arts Singaporeans who can perform at the competitive and world level.

sections.label: Fairness of deferment and NS
sections.summary: The passage asks whether it is fair that talents are not granted deferment while citizens by registration also do not do NS.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai
sentences.text: Is it fair that while we are hindering the development of our talents by not granting them deferment, citizens by registration are also not doing NS?

sections.label: Question unrelated to filed Parliamentary Question
sections.summary: The passage states that the question is not related to the Parliamentary Question that was filed.

sentences.speaker: Mdm Deputy Speaker
sentences.text: Your question is not related to the Parliamentary Question you have filed.
